latest_release.body:
# Pencil 4.0.0

Pencil 4.0 transforms Pencil into an AI-ready visual design studio! You can now pair your favorite AI coding assistants directly with Pencil to build, refine, and iterate on vector wireframes in real time.

---

### Key Highlights

- **Design Wireframes with AI**: Connect assistants like Claude Desktop, Cursor, Antigravity, and VS Code to design, arrange, and edit wireframes on your canvas using natural language.
- **Instant, Zero-Lag Canvas Updates**: AI operations happen in memory in real time, with no waiting on disk polling, reloads, or file saving.
- **Smart Auto-Layout Containers (`@group`)**: Group UI components into automatic horizontal (row) or vertical (column) stacks with automatic bounding boxes; say goodbye to manual pixel math and tedious coordinate nudging!
- **AI "Sees" What You See**: Connected assistants can request live canvas snapshots and cropped previews (`render_preview`) to visually inspect layout, typography, and contrast just like a human designer.
- **Watch Your AI Work Live**: See active edits in real time with live canvas animation overlays and a floating status pill (`AgentStatusPill`).

---

### Model Context Protocol (MCP) Features & Tools

- **Draw, Style & Rearrange**: Full control to add, update, reposition, group, align, and delete canvas elements (`insert_shapes`, `update_shapes`, `align_shapes`, `distribute_shapes`).
- **Full Document & Multi-Page Control**: Assistants can navigate and structure projects autonomously (`list_pages`, `create_page`, `rename_page`, `switch_page`).
- **Icon & Stencil Discovery**: Assistants can search installed icon libraries (Tabler, Lucide, FontAwesome) and discover UI components across all installed collections (`search_resources`, `list_collections`).
- **Privacy & Collection Governance**: Decide which stencil libraries and assets the AI can see, with complete toggle control in application preferences.
- **1-Click Assistant Setup**: Built-in configuration generator in **Settings > MCP** with one-click copying for popular assistants, plus server lifecycle controls (start/stop/restart) on `http://localhost:1919/mcp`.

---

### Canvas, Stencils & UI Enhancements

- Declarative 4-tier style resolution engine with type-scoped defaults and single-inheritance custom styles.
- Support for right-angle (90°) connectors (#380).
- New image editor tool with expand and shrink support for image data (`ImageEditDialog`).
- Support copying and pasting images across different Pencil documents (#393).
- Batch selection in Font Management Dialog.
- Configurable handle color for canvas editors.
- On-screen editing for blank plain text shapes.
- Create collection files directly in Stencil Generator (#645).
- Search and filter collections in Collection Management Dialog; view collection versions.
- Non-blocking update notification dialogs for Pencil and installed stencil collections.

---

### Bug Fixes & Improvements

- Fixed canvas shape dimension resizing in `update_shapes` and hardened top-level box schema.
- Fixed direct SVG transform manipulation in `update_shapes` and `insert_shapes`.
- Fixed rotation handling when rasterizing selection.
- Fixed HTML code colors not appearing in recently used colors (#422).
- Fixed menu positioning and implemented menu overflow mode for long menus (#603).
- Fixed image bounds invalidation on offscreen canvas.
- Fixed fallback handling in font editor for missing fonts.
- Fixed alignment options for Process shapes in Flowchart.
- Fixed text alignment for List Box shape.
- Fixed HTML entity rendering (`&`) in links.
- Removed obsolete OpenClipart pane.

Pencil

An open-source GUI prototyping and wireframing application for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

Website • Downloads • Stencils & Templates

![Pencil V4 Interface and Canvas](screenshot.png) --- ## Overview **Pencil** is a free, open-source, desktop-native wireframing and prototyping tool for macOS, Windows, and Linux ([pencil.evolus.vn](https://pencil.evolus.vn/)). Built for developers, UX designers, and product teams, it provides an intuitive vector canvas environment for constructing mockups, system diagrams, and user flows using standard vector stencil libraries. ### Key Capabilities & Architecture in V4.0 Pencil V4.0 introduces native support for the **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**. This enables any AI assistant or LLM client that supports standard MCP (including **Claude Desktop**, **Cursor**, **Antigravity**, **VS Code**, or custom agents) to inspect, create, and modify wireframes directly on your canvas using everyday language. Pencil runs a local server right inside the app at `http://127.0.0.1:1919/mcp`, with no extra background services or cloud setups required. - **Natural Language to Vector Canvas**: AI assistants convert prompts (e.g. *"Create a 3-tier pricing table using shadcn/ui"*) directly into canvas operations via MCP tools (`insert_shapes`, `shift_layout`). Components are positioned with calculated bounds, not flat image overlays. - **True Vector Primitives**: Generates native, fully editable vector stencils and shapes instead of raster bitmaps or static mockups. Every AI-created element can be resized, restyled, or reorganized on the canvas at any time. - **100% Local-First & Private**: All document data (`.ep`, `.epz`) and MCP requests stay strictly on your local machine over loopback (`127.0.0.1`). No cloud syncing, third-party analytics, or telemetry. - **Autonomous Vision QA Loop**: Exposes a visual snapshot mechanism (`render_preview`), allowing LLMs to inspect the rendered canvas, verify spacing/alignment/contrast, and perform iterative layout corrections autonomously. - **Dynamic Layout & Spacing**: Built-in container structures automatically manage padding, element distribution, and offsets, eliminating manual pixel math when appending or reordering components. - **Stencil & Icon Introspection**: Connected assistants can query installed stencil libraries (**shadcn/ui**, **Bootstrap**, **Material Design**, **iOS**, **Flowcharts**) and search icon catalogs (**Tabler**, **Lucide**, **FontAwesome**) on demand. --- ## Quick Start (Prebuilt Binaries) For end users who do not require building from source: 1. **Download**: Obtain the latest installer or package for your operating system from the [Pencil Downloads Page](https://pencil.evolus.vn/Downloads.html) or [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/evolus/pencil/releases). 2. **Launch**: Open Pencil. You can immediately begin creating wireframes and diagrams using the built-in stencil collections. 3. **Connect AI (Optional)**: To enable AI-assisted prototyping, follow the setup in [Connecting AI Clients](#connecting-ai-clients) below. --- ## Connecting AI Clients Pencil provides built-in configuration snippets for popular tools (**Claude Desktop**, **Cursor**, **Antigravity**, and **VS Code**), and works with any client or script that connects to standard MCP HTTP endpoints. Open **Settings > MCP**, select your assistant tab, and click **Copy Configuration** to paste directly into your client. The internal server operates on `http://127.0.0.1:1919/mcp` (Streamable HTTP / JSON-RPC 2.0). Server status, port assignment, and restarts can be managed directly in the MCP settings pane. To verify endpoint responsiveness externally: ```bash curl -I http://127.0.0.1:1919/mcp ```
Manual Client Configuration Reference
### Claude Desktop Add to `claude_desktop_config.json` (`~/Library/Application Support/Claude/` on macOS, `%APPDATA%\Claude\` on Windows, `~/.config/Claude/` on Linux): ```json { "mcpServers": { "pencil": { "command": "npx", "args": [ "-y", "mcp-remote", "http://127.0.0.1:1919/mcp" ] } } } ``` ### Cursor Add to `.cursor/mcp.json` or configure under **Settings > Features > MCP**: ```json { "mcpServers": { "pencil": { "url": "http://127.0.0.1:1919/mcp" } } } ``` ### Antigravity Add to `mcp_config.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "pencil": { "serverUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:1919/mcp" } } } ``` ### VS Code Add to `.vscode/mcp.json` (or user settings under `mcp.servers`): ```json { "servers": { "pencil": { "type": "http", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:1919/mcp" } } } ```
--- ## Example Interaction Prompts AI assistants connected to Pencil can execute complex multi-step canvas workflows. Below are representative prompts: > [!TIP] > **Prompting Best Practice**: For the cleanest layouts, explicitly reference your desired stencil library (e.g., *"Use shadcn/ui stencils..."* or *"Pick an icon from the Lucide collection..."*). This instructs the assistant to reuse standardized design system components instead of generic raw rectangles. ### Scaffolding New Screens - *"Use the shadcn/ui stencil collection to build a standard SaaS authentication screen with an email input, password field, 'Remember me' checkbox, and primary submit button."* - *"Create a three-tier pricing comparison table (Free, Pro, Enterprise) on the active page, highlighting the Pro tier with a primary accent border."* - *"Generate a mobile analytics dashboard page containing a top metrics card grid and a recent activity list below it."* ### Component Refinement & Styling - *"Select all primary call-to-action buttons on this page, update their background fill to #2563EB, and apply an 8px corner radius."* - *"Adjust the horizontal spacing between the navigation header items to 24px and align them vertically to the center."* - *"Convert the current card grid layout from 3 columns into a single-column list with 16px row gaps."* ### Icon & Asset Placement - *"Search the Tabler icon library for a 'settings' outline icon and place it in the top-right corner of the application bar."* - *"Replace the placeholder circles next to the username labels with user avatar icons from the Lucide collection."* ### Structural Layout Shifts & Visual QA - *"Shift the page footer down by 120px to make room for an email newsletter subscription block above it."* - *"Add a new page named 'Account Settings' with sub-tabs for 'General', 'Security', and 'Billing'."* - *"Inspect the current canvas preview for contrast issues or overlapping elements and adjust misaligned bounds."* --- ## MCP Tools Reference Pencil exposes its internal API through 5 catalog modules: | Category | Tools | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Canvas Mutation** | `insert_shapes`, `update_shapes`, `delete_shapes`, `move_shapes`, `align_shapes`, `distribute_shapes`, `shift_layout`, `select_shapes` | Create, modify, position, and reorder vector shapes, containers, and properties. | | **Document Management** | `get_active_document`, `get_page_content`, `list_pages`, `create_page`, `update_page`, `rename_page`, `delete_page`, `switch_page`, `export_page` | Manage document structure, multi-page hierarchies, navigation, and exports. | | **Inspection & Vision** | `render_preview`, `find_shapes`, `find_shapes_in_canvas`, `list_shapes` | Generate visual snapshots for LLM vision inspection and query shape hierarchies. | | **Stencils & Resources** | `list_collections`, `list_shape_definitions`, `get_shape_definition`, `list_resource_collections`, `list_resource_dir`, `search_resources` | Discover installed stencil libraries, component templates, and vector icon collections. | | **Guidance & Skills** | `list_skills`, `use_skill`, `read_knowledge_base_document` | Access embedded design rules, stencil construction guidelines, and best practices. | --- ## Stencil & Icon Ecosystem Pencil includes built-in collections and supports custom stencil installation: - **UI Framework Stencils**: shadcn/ui, Bootstrap, Material Design, iOS UI, Android UI, Web Elements. - **Diagramming & Flowcharts**: Flowchart shapes, UML diagrams, entity relationship symbols, mind mapping nodes. - **Vector Icon Catalogs**: Tabler Icons, Lucide Icons, FontAwesome. ### Stencil Repositories & Resources Additional collections and export templates can be installed through multiple sources: - **Official Stencils & Templates Directory**: Browse downloadable collections at [pencil.evolus.vn/Stencils-Templates.html](https://pencil.evolus.vn/Stencils-Templates.html). - **Community Stencils Repository**: Community-contributed collections are hosted on GitHub at [evolus/stencils-repository](https://github.com/evolus/stencils-repository). - **In-App Repository Browser**: In Pencil, open **Tools > Manage Collections** to browse the online repository, install stencils directly from archive URLs, or load local `.zip` packages created with the Stencil Generator. --- ## Development & Building from Source ### Prerequisites - **Node.js**: Version 14 or higher (LTS recommended) - **Package Manager**: npm or yarn - **Git** ### Installation 1. Clone the repository and check out the target branch: ```bash git clone https://github.com/evolus/pencil.git cd pencil git checkout development ``` 2. Install project dependencies: ```bash yarn install # or npm install ``` 3. Launch the development build: ```bash yarn start # or npm start ``` For dev tools and inspection windows enabled: ```bash npm run start:dev ``` ### Packaging & Distribution To compile production bundles for your host platform: ```bash # macOS (DMG, universal / arm64 / x64) npm run dist:osx # Windows (NSIS Installer) npm run dist:win32 # Linux (deb, rpm, tar.gz) npm run dist:linux ``` Output binaries are written to the `dist/` directory. --- ## Supported Platforms ### macOS - macOS 10.9 and later. - Native builds available for Apple Silicon (arm64) and Intel (x64). ### Windows - Windows 7, Windows 10, and Windows 11 (64-bit). ### Linux - Tested distributions: Ubuntu 18.04+, Debian 10+, Fedora 30+, Arch Linux. - Community packages: - **Arch Linux**: [AUR Package](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/pencil/) - **Gentoo Linux**: [media-gfx/evoluspencil](https://packages.gentoo.org/packages/media-gfx/evoluspencil) --- ## Contributing Contributions are welcome. Please refer to the following workflow: 1. Fork the repository and create a descriptive feature branch (`feature/your-feature-name`). 2. Adhere to existing code conventions and formatting guidelines defined in `.editorconfig`. 3. Test your changes locally across standard canvas operations and MCP endpoints. 4. Submit a pull request against the integration branch with a concise summary of changes. For security concerns or defect reports, please open an issue using the provided issue templates. --- ## Star History
